name: Kashiwagi Sumire
source:
[b]Scary yet warm-hearted part-time job senior[/b]

A senior at [url=/c143046]Iori[/url]'s part-time job.
She always looks grumpy, but it's just her bad attitude; once you get to know her, she's surprisingly kind.
She looks a little tough, but when you look closely, you'll see she's quite beautiful.
She is [url=/c142017]Yukari[/url]'s cousin and they get along well, they often hang out together since they live close to each other.
She loves cute things while worrying that they do not suit her.

[Translated from official user's manual]
